meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: Claude 会把你的问题交给一个模拟的“心灵议会”：选出 4-6 个不同思考风格的角色，让每个角色从自己的视角给出立场、理由和担忧，最后综合成一份报告，列出共识、核心分歧、盲点、建议做法和置信度。你还可以要求它用快速或深度模式、添加或排除某些角色。
howto.when: 当你说出“议会模式”、“帮我从多角度想想”等话，或要求进行魔鬼代言人分析、需要做艰难决定时触发。面对两难选择时也会自动启用。

say.text: 用议会模式帮我想想：该不该接受这个offer？
say.note: Claude 会召集多个角色给出多方观点。

say.text: 开个快速议会，讨论周末活动方案。
say.note: 会用 3 个成员、较短回答。

say.text: 启动魔鬼代言人模式，质疑我的年度计划。
say.note: 每个成员都挑战最直觉的方案。

howto.what_en: Claude simulates a 'mind council': it selects 4-6 archetypes with distinct thinking styles, each gives their perspective, then it synthesizes a report with consensus, key tension, blind spot, recommended path, and confidence. You can request quick/deep mode or customize members.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'council mode', 'help me think from multiple angles', or ask for devil's advocate analysis, or when facing a tough decision. Also activates on dilemmas or trade-offs with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Use council mode to help me decide: should I take this offer?
say_en.note: Claude will gather multiple roles for diverse views.

say_en.text: Run a quick council on weekend activity plans.
Activate devil's advocate mode to question my annual plan.
say_en.note: Every member challenges the most intuitive option.
